criteria.name: Problem Understanding
criteria.description: Ability to correctly understand and interpret the problem requirements

criteria.name: Solution Design
criteria.description: Quality of the approach to solving the problem

criteria.name: Implementation
criteria.description: Correctness and completeness of the code implementation

criteria.name: Testing
criteria.description: Adequacy of testing and validation of the solution

criteria.name: Documentation
criteria.description: Clarity of code documentation and comments

feedbackGuidelines.excellent: Exceptional problem-solving approach demonstrating deep understanding
feedbackGuidelines.good: Solid solution with clear thinking and good implementation
feedbackGuidelines.adequate: Basic solution meeting requirements but could be improved
feedbackGuidelines.needsWork: Solution shows gaps in understanding or approach

criteria.name: Code Quality
criteria.description: Readability, maintainability, and adherence to style guidelines

criteria.name: Functionality
criteria.description: Correctness of the code's behavior and output

criteria.name: Efficiency
criteria.description: Performance and optimal use of resources

criteria.name: Error Handling
criteria.description: Handling of edge cases, exceptions, and invalid inputs

criteria.name: Testing
criteria.description: Adequacy and quality of test coverage

feedbackGuidelines.excellent: Production-quality code with excellent structure and best practices
feedbackGuidelines.good: Well-written code with minor opportunities for improvement
feedbackGuidelines.adequate: Functional code but lacking in polish or best practices
feedbackGuidelines.needsWork: Code has significant issues affecting quality or correctness

criteria.name: Error Identification
criteria.description: Ability to correctly identify the root cause of the bug

criteria.name: Analysis
criteria.description: Quality of the systematic analysis process

criteria.name: Fix Implementation
criteria.description: Correctness and completeness of the fix applied

criteria.name: Verification
criteria.description: Confirmation that the fix resolves the issue without introducing new bugs

criteria.name: Documentation
criteria.description: Documentation of the bug and fix process

feedbackGuidelines.excellent: Masterful debugging with thorough analysis and verification
feedbackGuidelines.good: Effective debugging with clear reasoning and correct fix
feedbackGuidelines.adequate: Basic debugging skills with correct but potentially incomplete fix
feedbackGuidelines.needsWork: Debugging approach needs improvement or fix is incomplete

criteria.name: Scalability
criteria.description: Ability of the design to handle growth and increased load

criteria.name: Maintainability
criteria.description: Ease of future modifications and extensions

criteria.name: Robustness
criteria.description: Reliability and stability under various conditions

criteria.name: Efficiency
criteria.description: Optimal use of computational and human resources

criteria.name: Documentation
criteria.description: Clarity of architectural documentation and diagrams

feedbackGuidelines.good: Solid architecture with good trade-offs and clear rationale
feedbackGuidelines.adequate: Basic architecture meeting requirements but with room for improvement
feedbackGuidelines.needsWork: Architecture has significant design flaws or missing considerations
